subject.title: [Bug]: Slash command error——WebUI treats `/model status` as a model name instead of a slash-command subcommand

question: Should maintainers salvage the open conflicting fork PR, or supersede it with a fresh same-repo fix against the current WebUI executor path?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible on current main, but deterministic cleanup should not decide contributor-credit and branch-handling policy for a conflicting cross-repository PR.

options.title: Queue fresh same-repo fix
options.body: Supersede the stale conflicting fork branch and implement the narrow current-file fix with regression tests in the target repository.

options.title: Salvage the fork PR
options.body: Ask a maintainer or contributor to port the fork PR's concept from the old `ui/src/ui/chat` paths to current `ui/src/pages/chat` paths before review.

recommendation.title: Queue fresh same-repo fix
recommendation.body: Supersede the stale conflicting fork branch and implement the narrow current-file fix with regression tests in the target repository.

likelyOwner.reason: kklouzal most recently introduced and tested the current local slash-command executor path that needs the narrow repair.
